title: Module 33 — Databases & SQL
description: Model a normalized schema with a foreign key in sqlite3, insert data, run a JOIN with a GROUP BY aggregate, prove a transaction is all-or-nothing, add an index, and fix a redundant column. All work lives in a throwaway ~/db-lab directory.

steps.title: A normalized schema (users + orders, with a foreign key)
Insert data — and watch the foreign key reject a bad row
A JOIN with a GROUP BY aggregate
A transaction (COMMIT and ROLLBACK), then an index
A normalization fix — split the redundant column out
